name: Golden Cat Descendant
body:
Golden Cat Descendant
CR 6

XP 2,400
N Small animal (advanced cat)
Init +4; Senses low-light vision, scent; Perception +8

DEFENSE

AC 17, touch 15, flat-footed 13 (+4 Dex, +2 natural, +1 size)
hp 44 (8d8+8)
Fort +7, Ref +10, Will +5 (+3 vs. fear)
Defensive Abilities bravery +3; SR 14

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee bite +11 (1d4), 2 claws +12 (1d4+4)
Space 2 ft.; Reach 0 ft.
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 1st; concentration +1)

Constant—speak with animals
At will—guidance (30 ft. range)

STATISTICS

Str 11, Dex 18, Con 12, Int 4, Wis 16, Cha 11
Base Atk +6; CMB +5; CMD 19 (23 vs. trip)
Feats Improved Natural Attack (claw), Slashing Grace, Weapon Finesse, Weapon Focus (claw)
Skills Acrobatics +9, Climb +13, Perception +8, Stealth +17; Racial Modifiers +4 Climb, +4 Stealth
